title: How can I keep my blood glucose levels within the normal range using AAPS
symptom: The user is a parent of a 3-year-old child with type 1 diabetes using AndroidAPS closed-loop system, and is having difficulty keeping blood glucose stable. They ask how to use SMB and temporary basal rates together, which SMB features to enable, and how to adjust post-meal and overnight hormone rules.
evidence_quote: I am currently using the AAPS (AndroidAPS) closed-loop system to manage blood glucose. However, I am encountering some difficulties with AAPS and hope you can provide some assistance.
